title-info.book-title: Tribulation of Myriad Races — Chapter 1696: A dogs dao (3)

section.p: In his joy, the Dragon Pseudo Emperor shouted at the Spirit Pseudo Emperor and the Ape Pseudo Emperor, “Hang on! There is still hope! Devil Pseudo Emperor, is the previous Devil Pseudo Emperor really dead? If not, call him out! The Upper Realm can’t send too many people down here lest they incur the wrath of the heavens!”
Even with the addition of two Daofuses on their side, it still wouldn’t be so easy for them to reverse the situation. They needed more Daofuses from the Myriad Realms.
As for the Upper Realm Daofuses, it was unlikely that more would come as the heavenly laws would react with greater intensity with each intrusion. Nobody else would risk coming down.
The Dragon Pseudo Emperor had barely finished speaking when his tail was bitten off by the female furball. He howled in pain.

This bite was extremely painful. A bite from the female furball would not inflict mere physical damage. The damage extended toward his sea of willpower as well. This, this was far more painful than a regular physical wound.

That was the first sight the two new Daofuses saw right after arriving. Just as they were about to make a move, the book spirit sighed and said, “Why did you come down at this time? Are you here to throw your lives away? You even damaged your daos just to come down here. How foolish.”
Instantly, countless nets dropped down on them. At the same time, the tea plant sent numerous branches sweeping toward them. Their expressions changed drastically.
Right at that moment, Tiangu’s voice rang out throughout the Myriad Realms.

“Immortals, open the Immortal Transformation Pond fully. Since the divines and devils are unwilling to put more effort into this battle, the immortals will rescue our experts before withdrawing from the Allheaven Battlefield!”
At his order, the Immortal Transformation Pond was activated. Over twenty ancient immortals woke up from their deep slumber. Each was incredibly powerful. Before long, they received their orders.
Tiangu was making one thing clear.
The immortals were going all out.
They had deployed three Daofuses so far. On top of that, they had also deployed nearly a hundred immortal kings.
Of the major races, they had worked the hardest during this battle.

At this point, Tiangu was already tired of the divines and devils. Since they were still unwilling to fight seriously, he might as well withdraw. The immortals had suffered too much for this battle. Withdrawing safely was still possible with three Daofuses among their ranks.

Right at that moment, a sigh rang out. A projection appeared outside the Devil Realm and said, “Brother Tiangu, calm your anger. It’s not that we don’t want to put more effort, but I have been in deep slumber until moments ago. You need to give me some time to wake up properly, right?”
Su Yu was still working hard on his advancement.
When he heard the new voice, he frowned.
Holy shit!

The myriad races sure had a lot of old fossils to spare. More importantly, they had even gained additional helpers from the Upper Realm. Weren’t the heavenly laws supposed to punish them for descending before the time was up?

Su Yu had thought that the punishment would be heavy enough to kill, but the two had survived the descent. They had merely suffered some injuries. Yes, their injuries were heavy. But heavily injured Daofuses were still Daofuses.
Would there be no end to his?
Damn it!
Would he be forced to face a never-ending stream of enemies?

Just then, the old turtle’s voice rang out, “Since two have descended, would anyone else dare to descend? The barrier of laws has yet to open. The second person to descend will face a stronger punishment. The third to descend will have a very low chance of surviving. As for the fourth to descend, surviving is impossible. Show me. Just how many people can you send down here?”

He looked at the faraway Devil Realm and said, “So you’re still alive, Mo Ji. But the injuries on you are still quite severe. Come, then. Let us do battle. Let’s see how much longer you can live after a battle with me.”
The old turtle sounded incredibly domineering.
“Thirty thousand years ago, you forced your way into the Death Realm and disturbed the Celestial River of Death while I was distracted. I’ve been wanting to settle this debt with you.”
Slowly, an ancient expert appeared outside the Devil Realm.
He said, “Brother Grand Dream, I did that to save my fellow devils. I never intended to offend you. Mo Yue is still young and ignorant. Please forgive his offenses.”
Mo Yue was none other than the current Devil Pseudo Emperor.
At the moment, he was in the middle of receiving a heavy beating from the old turtle. Inwardly, he was begging the newly arrived devil to start fighting already.
Just stop talking already! He was dying here!
The old turtle glanced at Su Yu and said, “Focus on your advancement. Don’t worry about us. You already did your best. In fact, you did very well. Not even Mo Ji can stop our momentum anymore.”
Then, he started moving toward the Devil Realm while blasting the Devil Pseudo Emperor and Nether Pseudo Emperor in the same direction.
He vowed to stop even Mo Ji as well.

Mo Ji, as the previous Devil Pseudo Emperor, wasn’t weak. But he had sustained heavy injuries from his intrusion into the Death Realm back then. He might still be suffering from those injuries as he wouldn’t have gone missing for so long otherwise.

Even further away, Tiangu snorted. He wasn’t even surprised. Mo Yue wouldn’t have been picked as the new Devil Pseudo Emperor otherwise. Sure enough, Mo Ji wasn’t dead. He sure was patient. It was unknown if he had really only awakened recently or if he had merely been hiding away because he didn’t want to join the fight this early.
Mo Ji and the two from the Upper Realm would be enough to get them out of their current predicament.
Tiangu moved his gaze and focused on Jiwu instead.
Jiwu, the Divine Pseudo Emperor, said helplessly, “Don’t look at me like that. We really don’t have any other Daofuses remaining down here. They would have shown up long ago otherwise.”
It was pointless to look at him like that. He was being honest here. Tiangu decided to trust the Divine Pseudo Emperor for now.
“Awaken your slumbering Eternals as well. We need to stop humanity’s momentum or we might face destruction before the thousand-year limit is even up.
The Divine Pseudo Emperor did not protest.
A unique power undulated out of him.
Then, several old fossils carrying a thick smell of rot emerged from the Divine Realm. They looked both surprised and confused.
Had the war started?
The tenth epochal war?
Why was it starting so early? They only needed to focus slightly to see that the thousand-year limit had yet to arrive.

Since they had just awakened, they had yet to fully regain their previous strength. It would be quite hard for them to survive for long if they went into battle in their current state. They were doubtful, but they didn’t have the luxury to wait since chaos had erupted. Thus, they charged toward the distant Great Qin King, the nearest human expert to them.
When Great Qin King looked at them, he gasped. Oh my! About eight eighth and ninth degree Eternals were heading toward him. Instead of remaining as domineering as ever, he started fleeing.

Some old fossils also emerged from the Immortal Realm before flying toward the Human Realm. Having escalated the war to this level, it wouldn’t end before one party suffered enough to not want to fight anymore.
Meanwhile, Su Yu was still focused on himself.
Advancement.

Since the old turtle had said that it would be fine, so be it. He believed in the old turtle. He would only worry after the old turtle was beaten back. His aura continued surging as his advancement continued. He was aiming to enter the Sunmoon Realm this time.
With a stomp, he opened a new death tunnel under him.
Instantly, He Tu and more than ten death sovereigns emerged from it. This time, these death sovereigns weren’t here as He Tu’s friends. Rather, they had been in pursuit of He Tu.
He Tu was luring them around with the death blood of a marquis.

Su Yu ignored them and moved elsewhere before opening another death tunnel with a stomp, releasing Xia Chen and more than ten death sovereigns. Having released the two, Su Yu sent them a voice transmission, “Move toward the Immortal Realm.”
“We will be punished if we go too far.”
He Tu said, “Are you stupid? If we go far, the heavenly laws will view it as you losing control over us and punish you!”
Su Yu rolled his eyes. Of course he knew that. Hence why he wanted them to do exactly that. He loved tribulations. How was he supposed to milk the heavenly laws without the tribulations?
Since Su Yu was insisting, He Tu and Xia Chen did not hesitate.
Charge!
With death blood on them, they started flying toward the Immortal Realm, followed by over thirty death sovereigns. Deep inside, these death sovereigns were feeling quite nervous.
Holy shit!
Why were there so many big guys here?

Yes, death spirits weren’t the brightest, but they weren’t brainless. They knew that this wasn’t the type of place they should stay. Yes, they had an innate desire to slaughter, but this place was too scary for them.
Yes. Death spirits knew fear as well.
A massive war between the myriad races had erupted here.

More than ten Daofuses were fighting here. And Su Yu had shut the death tunnels they had emerged from. Thus, they were left with no choice but to run off with He Tu. At the very least, He Tu wouldn’t be dumb enough to throw his life away, right?

Thus, the death sovereigns made the smart choice and continued following He Tu. There were enough of them that everyone noticed them, but everyone was also too busy to deal with them. The battle was too intense for them to let some death spirits distract them.

In such a manner, the death spirits and the newly emerged immortals started moving in each other’s direction. It might look like the death spirits were here to unleash disaster, but they were currently more akin to war refugees.

This damn place was simply too scary. They had to run. Even if they could sense the approaching immortals, they still had to run there. After all, facing a bunch of Invincibles was far better than facing a bunch of Daofuses. They could even vent some of their anger on those immortals.
Not long after they left, a blood tribulation started appearing in the sky. The old turtle looked at the sky and gasped.
How brazen!
Back then, He Tu had done the same. Ultimately, he died. The old turtle had personally delivered the punishment. Why was Su Yu playing the same game again? Was he not afraid of it backfiring on him?
The tribulations had arrived.
If Su Yu couldn’t take care of it, even the guardians would be punished.
“Su Yu! Don’t mess things up!”
The old turtle started worrying. He could only hope that Su Yu wouldn’t do anything stupid. Things weren’t that desperate for them yet. There was no need for Su Yu to take such a huge risk.
Su Yu laughed and said, “Don’t worry, Lord. It will be fine.”
Don’t worry his ass!

Alas, the old turtle was too busy to do anything. A powerful existence had arrived. After catching Mo Yue, who had just been sent flying by the old turtle, the newcomer looked at Su Yu and sighed, “The youngsters nowadays sure are crazy.”
How brazen.
Using the death spirits to deal with the reinforcements from the Immortal Realm while facing the tribulations alone. Was he sure this would work?
Su Yu’s answer was a resounding yes. He was already a veteran at this. This wasn’t his first time doing something like this.
